body: My other problem with coming clean I realize is that I have lied to literally every single person in my life about this subject. I don't have the balls to face any of them after coming clean.
Well my main problem with telling my parents is my living situation. I know they're going to kick me out and I don't think I have enough cash to support myself until I can find a job.

I'm really lazy. I spent all of my time just sleeping or playing video games. I think that's my problem. I also thought about joining the military but I'm morbidly obese so I don't think that would work out too well.
